Here is a review of the bugs found in the provided Python code:

ISSUE: line 19 | The `get` method does not update the recency of the accessed item. In an LRU cache, a cache hit should move the item to the most-recently-used position. This can be fixed by calling `self.data.move_to_end(key)` before returning the value.
ISSUE: line 43 | The `hit_rate` method will raise a `ZeroDivisionError` if it is called before any `get` calls have been made (i.e., when `total` is 0). It should return 0.0 (or handle the division by zero) in that case.
ISSUE: line 59 | The `cached` decorator uses `result is None` to check for a cache miss. If the decorated function legitimately returns `None`, this will incorrectly treat it as a miss and re-evaluate the function on every call, breaking the memoization. A sentinel object should be used as the default instead of `None`.
